name: Morguard North American Residential Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Morguard North American Residential Real Estate Investment Trust is an unincorporated, open-ended real estate investment trust which owns, through a limited partnership, interests in Canadian residential apartment communities, located in Alberta and Ontario, and U.S. residential apartment communities located in Colorado, Texas, Louisiana, Illinois, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Virginia and Maryland with an appraised value of approximately 4.4 billion dollars at September 30, 2026. Morguard North American Residential Real Estate Investment Trust was established in 2012 and was incorporated in Canada.
